title: pcct-vmi-core: a spectral simulation testbed for task detectability and quantitation after denoising of photon-counting-detector CT virtual monoenergetic images
description:
Synthetic spectral simulation testbed (polyenergetic forward model, two-bin photon-counting detection, FBP reconstruction, water/iodine basis decomposition, virtual monoenergetic image synthesis) for studying how AI denoising shifts detectability-optimal energy and affects iodine quantitation in PCD-CT VMI stacks.

This release is the version archived for the manuscript. It carries the frozen result JSON files from which every figure and table is regenerated, the figure-drawing code, the trained denoiser weights, and the submission gates. No image data is redistributed. The walnut reconstructions used in the real-data stress test are obtained from their own public record following docs/DATA.md.
